title: fix(studio): permission title, AI panel 正在看 line and field panel header use names, not internal names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Part of #35018 (PR 1 of 2: card items 1–3, the Studio surfaces. Item 4, the landing page app cards and 最近访问, is PR 2.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 三处不再显示内部名。权限页标题只写权限集名字；标题下方和页签右侧改成业务说法（「随应用提供」「本应用对象 · 发布后生效」）。权限栏、自动化栏的 AI 面板「正在看」改为「权限 · 组织成员」「流程 · 新会议提醒」。字段属性面板合并成一行标题、一个关闭按钮，内部名只在「开发者信息」里；右栏底部「AI 助手 / 回到对话 →」条去掉。
- 为什么改：卡片 #35018 的界面实测：应用名在标题里重复，AI 面板显示 `permission · app_…_member_access`，字段面板两行标题、两个关闭按钮。
- 风险与回滚：只改显示和文案，不改数据、接口和布局。底部回到对话条是右栏共用的，自动化栏、界面栏也一起去掉，顶部「属性 | AI 助手」切换做同样的事。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（字段面板 InspectorShellHostProvider 那一段，和权限栏、自动化栏的「正在看」上报）、`StudioRightSlot.tsx`（去掉底部条）、`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`（标题一行）。
- 两分钟验证：中文 Studio 打开自建应用的「权限」栏选一个权限集，标题只显示权限集名字；打开 AI 面板，输入框上方显示「正在看：权限 · 权限集名字」；在「数据」栏表单里点一个字段，属性面板只有一行标题、面板里只有一个关闭按钮，看不到 `meeting_name` 这类内部名。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Permission page (item 1).** `PermissionMatrixEditor` Studio header: the title is the set's label alone. `PermissionStudioChrome.appLabel` and `AccessPillar`'s `packageLabel` prop (added by #34795 only to prefix the title) are removed. The note under the title reads `engine.studio.access.origin.app` (随应用提供 / "Included with the app") instead of `perm.badge.package` (包内置). The Setup page badge keeps `perm.badge.package`. The tab-row note `engine.studio.access.banner` / `bannerPair` reads 本应用对象 · 发布后生效. Its hover texts (`bannerTitle`, `bannerTitlePair`, `bannerTitleReadOnly`) say "app" for "package" and no longer name a 「Save」 button.
- **AI panel 正在看 (item 2).** `AccessPillar` and `AutomationsPillar` report the open item's label to the copilot through `onSurfaceLabelChange`, the seam the Data and Interfaces pillars already use: `权限 · LABEL` (the record-visibility overview reads `权限 · 谁能看到哪些记录`) and `流程 · LABEL` (the label the flow canvas header reads). The chip's hover title keeps `type · name`, and the agent's `context.surface` is unchanged. The Interfaces rail already read labels on main (pinned by `StudioDesignSurface.aiChipLabel`), so it is not changed here.
- **Field properties panel (item 3).** The Data pillar's field rail hosts `ObjectFieldInspector` under `InspectorShellHostProvider`. This is the objectui#12488 seam the flow inspector uses. The rail's `StudioInspector` header is now the only header: 字段属性, the field's label, the inspector's own actions (duplicate, reorder, ⋯ menu) portaled into its slot, and one close button. The machine name is no longer under the header. It stays in the inspector's collapsed 开发者信息. `StudioRightSlot` loses its foot strip. The header's 属性 | AI 助手 switch does the same thing and carries the same pending count. `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` itself needed no change.
- Three new `studio` namespace keys (lazy namespace, not the eager en pack): `engine.studio.access.origin.app`, `engine.studio.copilot.subject.access`, `engine.studio.copilot.subject.flow`. zh and en are kept in step.

## Why

Card #35018 items 1–3, measured on main in the card's browser walk and again in this PR's before leg (below).

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins (card-named, beside each file's existing tests)</summary>

- Item 1, `StudioDesignSurface.accessWording-34795.test.tsx`: the title's text is exactly the set label (`组织成员`) and the header holds no app name. A new case checks that the note reads the origin key · default and that the header has no 包内置 and no 本包. The #34795 "app · set label" case is rewritten to the card's ruling.
- Item 2, `StudioDesignSurface.aiChipLabel.test.tsx`: a new describe mounts the real surface, dock and ChatPane at `/access?surface=permission:SET` and `/automations?surface=flow:FLOW`. The chip reads `正在看：权限 · 组织成员` / `正在看：流程 · 新会议提醒`, contains neither `permission`/`flow` nor the machine name, its title is `type · name`, and the agent surface is the URL's.
- Item 3, `DataPillar.readOnlyRailReason-12303.test.tsx` (real registered `ObjectFieldInspector`): exactly one `Close` button in the rail, one `header`, the header titled by the field label and holding the ⋯ menu, the inspector hosted (`inspector-shell-hosted`). The field's machine name is not in the visible text by default. CONTROL: the developer section's API-name input becomes visible after its toggle.
- Updated for the change: the strip pins in `pillarsClaimSlot-12725`, `rightSlot-12725`, `leafColumnSelection-12725`, `kanbanCardSelection-12725` and `__tests__/studioRightSlot-12725` now drive the header switch and assert no strip. The Studio badge text in `accessTabs-12456`, `accessPairCopy-29674` and `PermissionMatrixEditor.badge` (studio site only) is updated. `baseObjectExtension-28575` reads the field's name from 开发者信息 instead of the header.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, at 992a138c2c; each restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- Item 1: `const studioTitle = headerLabel || name;` → an app-prefixed title. `accessWording-34795`: 1 failed / 12 passed (the title case). Restored blob 91c0958ffd00 == HEAD.
- Item 2: the Access report's `` `${accessSubject} · ${currentSetLabel}` `` → `undefined`. `aiChipLabel`: 1 failed / 3 passed (the Access case, chip fell back to `type · name`). Restored blob f55bc71521c0 == HEAD.
- Item 3: `InspectorShellHostProvider value={{ … fieldHeaderSlot }}` → `value={null}`. `readOnlyRailReason-12303`: 2 failed / 4 passed (one-header case and the ⋯-menu-in-header case). Restored blob f55bc71521c0 == HEAD.

</details>

<details><summary>Suites (local, under os-verify-lock)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ …/PermissionMatrixEditor …/inspectors/` at 21b627fe16: Test Files 626 passed, 1 failed (627). The one failure was `PermissionMatrixEditor.badge` studio site, fixed in 992a138c2c. Re-run there: 3 files / 33 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` (src and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 171 files passed, 2 skipped. The first run was killed by the box's OOM killer while the studio suite ran beside it, so it reads NOT MEASURED. This re-run ran alone.
- adeba0162c changes only locale values and the changeset after these runs (no test reads the reworded literals). The changeset gates and `check:test-source-alias` were re-run there: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live reading** (zh-CN, 1280×800, fresh showcase backend + console served from src). A self-built app was created over HTTP: package `com.qa.mtg` 会议纪要, object 会议 with 会议名称, permission set 组织成员, flow 新会议提醒. Stand-in: `/api/v1/ai/**` answers an agents list with a build agent, so Studio serves its AI panel; no model is called. Before = the five changed source files checked out at the merge base, vite restarted with `--force`, served code checked with `curl`. After = branch head, served code checked the same way.
  - Before: title 「会议纪要 · 组织成员」, note 「包内置 · 新用户默认」, tab row 「仅本包对象 · 保存为草稿」; Access 「正在看：permission · mtg_member_access」, Automations 「正在看：flow · mtg_new_meeting_alert」; field panel 2 close buttons, header 「字段属性 meeting_name」, `meeting_name` visible, foot strip present.
  - After: title 「组织成员」, note 「随应用提供 · 新用户默认」, tab row 「本应用对象 · 发布后生效」; Access 「正在看：权限 · 组织成员」, Automations 「正在看：流程 · 新会议提醒」; field panel 1 close button, header 「字段属性 会议名称」, `meeting_name` not visible by default, no foot strip.
  - My first wording (本应用的对象) was one character wider than main's and got cut at the tab row's right edge with the AI panel open. The shipped wording has main's width and fits (after shot).
- The card's own app had a set authored as 「会议纪要·组织成员」. Its title now reads that authored label as written, once. The app name is no longer added by Studio. A label that itself names the app is the author's text, and this PR does not rewrite it.
- The foot strip lived in `StudioRightSlot.tsx`, not `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`. The claim's PR 1 surface named the inspector file, so this file is an addition to the claim's surface. The strip is shared slot chrome, so it also goes on the Automations and Interfaces rails. Their property panels themselves (#34796) are not touched.

## Verification

Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (38) plus `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` (a roster under `.changeset/`), run locally at 21b627fe16 / 992a138c2c. All exit 0, except three first-run reds, each resolved:
- `pnpm check:test-source-alias`: exit 1 (two edited slot tests and the badge test lacked module-top preloads). Fixed in 992a138c2c, re-run exit 0.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (its build did not get the lock). Re-run: exit 0, "0 ledger entr(ies) re-measured … none above its recorded number".
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: SIGKILL (OOM, box contention). Re-run alone: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0 (no anchored files). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-35018-studio-names-a`: VERDICT clean (main, #34978, #34925 merge cleanly).
- The CI type-check lanes and repo-wide scans are CI's.
